第1章 太阳神体镇天碑（第1页）
一女子身披白色纱衣立于佛前，肌肤如雪，青丝如瀑，似仙女下凡。
叶凡注视眼前女子，喉咙不由自主地滑动了下。
把他死死摁住，疯狂撕扯起了他的衣服。
指尖冰凉，触碰到他皮肤的瞬间，竟激起一阵炽热。
“当着佛祖的面，仙女可不能乱来呀……”
叶凡话未说完，便被红唇封住了嘴唇。
叶凡，本是蓝星上一个苦逼的牛马。
加班猝死，这才刚穿越来这天穹大陆。
还没接受穿越的事实，就碰上了这好事。
待天明，精疲力竭的叶凡躺在地上。
此时其身侧女子，脸庞已褪去潮红。
叶凡吓得惊坐而起，忙抓起一块破布遮身，缩到了角落。
女子抬手一招，地上长剑飞入手中，剑锋直指叶凡咽喉，再进一寸即可叶凡性命。
叶凡吓得不敢动弹，连忙解释道，“昨晚我都是被迫的……我曾拼死反抗过，只是仙女的力气，实在太大了……”
女子皱眉，回想起了昨夜点点滴滴。
“昨日我遭贼人算计，身中奇毒，才会做出如此荒唐之事，不怪你。”

女子语气冰冷，缓缓放下了手中之剑，“但此事你若传了出去，我必取你性命。”
叶凡可不敢招惹对方，一脸谄媚道，“仙女您也不必自责，我不用你对我负责的。”
女子没再理会叶凡，简直完事无情。
背过身，开始穿戴起散落在地的衣物。
这时，庙内佛像双眸射出一道不易察觉的异芒，悄无声息刺入叶凡眉心。
下一瞬，他就被带到了一片混沌世界。
“小子！老夫等了千年，终于等到你了。”
老者缓缓道，“老夫乃太阳神帝！可惜，如今仅剩一道残魂，暂存于佛像之中。”
叶凡神色一怔，低声嘀咕道，“昨夜破庙内发生的事，你不会全看到了吧？”

Chapter 1 The Monument of the Sun Divine Body to Suppress the Sky (Page 1)
A woman wearing a white gauze dress stands in front of the Buddha. Her skin is like snow and her green hair is like a waterfall, like a fairy descending to earth.
Ye Fan stared at the woman in front of him, and his throat slid involuntarily.
He held him tightly and tore his clothes frantically.
The fingertips were cold, but the moment they touched his skin, a burst of heat arose.
"In front of the Buddha, fairies can't mess around..."
Before Ye Fan finished speaking, his lips were sealed by red lips.
Ye Fan was originally a hard-working guy on Blue Star.
He died suddenly while working overtime, and he had just traveled to the Sky Continent.
This good thing happened before I could accept the fact of time travel.
At dawn, exhausted Ye Fan lay on the ground.
At this time, the flushed face of the woman beside him had faded.
Ye Fan was so frightened that he sat up, quickly grabbed a piece of rag to cover himself, and shrank into a corner.
The woman raised her hand and made a move, and the long sword from the ground flew into her hand. The blade of the sword was pointed directly at Ye Fan's throat. Another inch could kill Ye Fan.
Ye Fan was too scared to move, and quickly explained, "I was forced last night... I tried my best to resist, but the fairy's strength was too great..."
The woman frowned, recalling every detail of last night.
"Yesterday, I was plotted by thieves and was poisoned by a strange poison. That's why I did such a ridiculous thing. I don't blame you."
The woman's tone was cold, and she slowly put down the sword in her hand, "But if you spread this matter, I will take your life."
Ye Fan didn't dare to provoke the other party, and said with a flattering look, "Fairy, you don't have to blame yourself, I don't need you to be responsible for me."
The woman ignored Ye Fan and was so heartless.
Turning around, he started to put on the clothes scattered on the ground.
At this time, the eyes of the Buddha statue in the temple shot out a strange light that was not easy to detect, and silently pierced Ye Fan's eyebrows.
The next moment, he was brought to a world of chaos.
"Boy! I've been waiting for a thousand years, and finally I'm waiting for you."
The old man said slowly, "I am the Sun God Emperor! Unfortunately, there is only one remnant soul left, which is temporarily stored in the Buddha statue."
Ye Fan looked stunned and whispered, "You didn't see everything that happened in the ruined temple last night, did you?"
